_note: Core + detachment stratagems, keyed by id. See NEW_ARMY_BUILD_GUIDE.md §4.4. detachment:null means a Core stratagem, available in every list. CP costs, turn and phase tags match Wahapedia's 11th edition pages (read 2026-10-12); WHEN / TARGET / EFFECT are summaries. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the loader.
_phases_note: `phases` follows the phase icons on each stratagem card, which can list more than the phase named in WHEN — Mow ’Em Down and Unbridled Carnage are used in the Fight phase but also carry the Charge icon, because they only work for a unit that charged. 'Any phase' is stored as all five.
_whileCalled_note: whileCalled: what the stratagem gains if its target is riled up. While the Waaagh! is active the card is marked and the popup shows this line; the full wording is always in `effect`.

command-re-roll.name: Command Re-roll
command-re-roll.summary: Re-roll one roll you just made.
command-re-roll.when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance, Charge, Damage, Hazard, Hit, Save or Wound roll, or a roll for the number of attacks a weapon makes, for a friendly unit or model.
command-re-roll.effect: Re-roll that roll. If several dice were rolled together, re-roll one of them — except a Charge roll, which is re-rolled in full.

epic-challenge.name: Epic Challenge
epic-challenge.when: Fight phase, just after a friendly CHARACTER unit is selected to fight.
epic-challenge.effect: Select one CHARACTER model in your unit. Until the end of the phase, its melee weapons have [PRECISION].

insane-bravery.name: Insane Bravery
insane-bravery.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you make a Battle-shock roll for a friendly unit.
insane-bravery.effect: That Battle-shock roll is automatically successful.
insane-bravery.restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem more than once per battle.

explosives.name: Explosives
explosives.summary: Six D6 at a unit within 8": each 4+ is a mortal wound.
explosives.target: One friendly unengaged EXPLOSIVES or GRENADES unit that is eligible to shoot and did not Advance this turn.
explosives.effect: Select one EXPLOSIVES/GRENADES model in your unit, then one unengaged enemy unit within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

crushing-impact.name: Crushing Impact
crushing-impact.summary: A charging MONSTER or VEHICLE rolls D6s equal to its Toughness.
crushing-impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a friendly MONSTER or VEHICLE unit ends a Charge move.
crushing-impact.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit, and one model in your unit engaged with it. Roll a number of D6 equal to that model’s T: each 1 deals 1 mortal wound to your unit, and each 5+ deals 1 mortal wound to the enemy unit (maximum 6 mortal wounds per unit).

rapid-ingress.name: Rapid Ingress
rapid-ingress.summary: A unit in Strategic Reserves arrives in your opponent's turn.
rapid-ingress.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
rapid-ingress.target: One friendly unit that is in Strategic Reserves (excluding AIRCRAFT).
rapid-ingress.effect: Your unit makes an ingress move.
rapid-ingress.restrictions: You cannot use this stratagem during the first battle round.

fire-overwatch.name: Fire Overwatch
fire-overwatch.summary: Snap shooting: one target within 24", hitting on 6s only.
fire-overwatch.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
fire-overwatch.effect: Your unit shoots using snap shooting: it can target only one visible enemy unit within 24", each attack hits only on an unmodified Hit roll of 6 (and those hits are not Critical Hits), and Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled. Afterwards your unit cannot start an action until the end of the phase.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.summary: A SMOKE unit, and units behind it, get the Benefit of Cover.
smokescreen.when: Start of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
smokescreen.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your SMOKE unit — or a unit that is not fully visible to the attacking model because of models in your SMOKE unit — the target has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

heroic-intervention.name: Heroic Intervention
heroic-intervention.summary: Charge at the end of your opponent's Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
heroic-intervention.target: One friendly unengaged unit within 12" of one or more enemy units. A VEHICLE unit can only be selected if it is a CHARACTER or WALKER unit.
heroic-intervention.effect:
Resolve a charge with your unit, picking one mode before the Charge roll:
• Leap to Defend — its charge targets must be enemy units that made a Charge move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
• Into the Fray (+1CP) — a Charge roll above 6 (after modifiers) becomes 6, but its charge targets can be any enemy units within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

counteroffensive.name: Counteroffensive
counteroffensive.summary: Your unit gains Fights First and fights next.
counteroffensive.when: Fight step of your opponent’s Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has resolved its attacks.
counteroffensive.target: One friendly unit that is eligible to fight.
counteroffensive.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

_combat_patrol_note: The three ’Ardmob stratagems below belong to the Combat Patrol detachment in data/combat-patrol/index.json. Wahapedia does not carry Combat Patrol content, so they are unchanged from before the 11th edition sync and have NOT been re-verified. They show on the Combat Patrol tab's Stratagems view, not on the matched-play Stratagems tab.

krump-em.name: Krump ’Em
krump-em.summary: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
krump-em.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ’ARDMOB unit is selected to fight.

medi-squigs.name: Medi-Squigs
medi-squigs.summary: Your unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.
medi-squigs.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ’ARDMOB unit.

get-stuck-in.name: Get Stuck In
get-stuck-in.summary: Surge move up to D6+1" after being shot at.
get-stuck-in.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged ’ARDMOB unit has shot.
get-stuck-in.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".

breakin-heads.name: Breakin’ Heads
breakin-heads.summary: D3 mortal wounds to shake off Battle-shock.
breakin-heads.when: Any phase, when a friendly Attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes Battle-shocked.
breakin-heads.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. It can be targeted even though it is Battle-shocked.
breakin-heads.effect: Roll one D3: your unit suffers that many mortal wounds, and is no longer Battle-shocked.

hit-em-harder.name: Hit ’Em Harder
hit-em-harder.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
hit-em-harder.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

orks-is-never-beaten.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
orks-is-never-beaten.summary: Destroyed models fight before they are removed, on a 4+.
orks-is-never-beaten.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
orks-is-never-beaten.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is riled up. On a 4+ that model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until your unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

mow-em-down.name: Mow ’Em Down
mow-em-down.summary: A charging vehicle's melee attacks gain [CLEAVE 1].
mow-em-down.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a Charge move this turn is selected to fight.
mow-em-down.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1] — or, if an attack already has [CLEAVE], its value goes up by 1.

fungus-fuel-injection.name: Fungus-fuel Injection
fungus-fuel-injection.summary: +2" Move for a MOUNTED or VEHICLE unit.
fungus-fuel-injection.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED or ORKS VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

close-range-dakka.name: Close-range Dakka
close-range-dakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
close-range-dakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [RAPID FIRE 1] — or, if an attack already has [RAPID FIRE], its value goes up by 1.

unbridled-carnage.name: Unbridled Carnage
unbridled-carnage.summary: +1 Attack in melee for Boyz that charged.
unbridled-carnage.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a Charge move this turn is selected to fight.

mob-mentality.name: Mob Mentality
mob-mentality.summary: A big mob steadies a nearby unit's Battle-shock rolls.
mob-mentality.when: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
mob-mentality.target: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13 or more models.
mob-mentality.effect: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s Battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

ere-we-go.name: ’Ere We Go
ere-we-go.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ or BOYZ unit is selected to move.
ere-we-go.effect: Your unit has +2 to Advance rolls.

too-arrogant-to-die.name: Too Arrogant To Die
too-arrogant-to-die.summary: Destroyed models fight before they are removed, on a 4+.
too-arrogant-to-die.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
too-arrogant-to-die.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit is riled up. On a 4+ that model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until your unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

armed-to-da-teef.name: Armed to da Teef
armed-to-da-teef.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 — or all of them while riled up.
armed-to-da-teef.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit is selected to attack.
armed-to-da-teef.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1. If your unit is riled up, they can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
armed-to-da-teef.whileCalled: Re-roll the whole Hit roll, not just 1s

hulking-brutes.name: Hulking Brutes
hulking-brutes.cpCostNote: +1 CP to drop the Strength condition
hulking-brutes.summary: -1 to Wound for ranged attacks whose Strength beats your Toughness.
hulking-brutes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ or NOBZ unit.
hulking-brutes.effect:
Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to Wound rolls.
• Or (+1CP): every ranged attack that targets your unit has -1 to Wound rolls.

infested-war-zone.name: Infested War Zone
infested-war-zone.summary: A destroyed Gretchin unit returns to Strategic Reserves at full strength.
infested-war-zone.when: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
infested-war-zone.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. It can be targeted even though it was just destroyed.
infested-war-zone.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army, identical to the destroyed one. It goes into Strategic Reserves at its Starting Strength with all its wounds.

scarper.name: Scarper!
scarper.summary: Gretchin move D6" when the enemy closes in.
scarper.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.
scarper.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" — or of up to 6" instead if it is an Attached unit.

grot-shields.name: Grot Shields
grot-shields.summary: Nearby Gretchin soak up hits meant for another unit.
grot-shields.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).
grot-shields.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
grot-shields.effect: Each time one of that enemy unit’s ranged attacks against that ORKS unit scores a hit, if a model from your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, that attack’s sequence ends and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound instead.

kustom-dakka.name: Kustom Dakka
kustom-dakka.summary: +1 to Wound against anything that is not a Monster or Vehicle.
kustom-dakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
kustom-dakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER and VEHICLE units) have +1 to Wound rolls.

glowin-dakka.name: Glowin’ Dakka
glowin-dakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
glowin-dakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

never-enough-dakka.name: Never Enough Dakka
never-enough-dakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
never-enough-dakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

dubious-restraint.name: Dubious Restraint
dubious-restraint.summary: Secure an objective your unit controls.
dubious-restraint.when: Start or end of your Movement phase.
dubious-restraint.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

mind-mostly-on-the-mission.name: Mind Mostly on the Mission
mind-mostly-on-the-mission.summary: Advance or Fall Back and still start an action.
mind-mostly-on-the-mission.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move.
mind-mostly-on-the-mission.effect: That move does not stop your unit from starting an action.

while-their-backs-are-turned.name: While Their Backs Are Turned
while-their-backs-are-turned.summary: A 6" move after the enemy disengages.
while-their-backs-are-turned.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
while-their-backs-are-turned.target: One friendly unengaged BOYZ, KOMMANDOS or STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
while-their-backs-are-turned.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

drive-by-bustin.name: Drive-by Bustin’
drive-by-bustin.summary: +1 to Hit for weapons fired through a Firing Deck.
drive-by-bustin.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.
drive-by-bustin.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks made with weapons selected for its Firing Deck ability have +1 to Hit rolls.

grab-it.name: Grab It
grab-it.summary: Shoot, then move 6" onto an objective.
grab-it.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ, FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.
grab-it.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", which must end within range of an objective. It cannot declare a charge until the end of the turn.

gun-crazy-show-offs.name: Gun-crazy Show-offs
gun-crazy-show-offs.summary: Shoot back at the unit that just shot you.
gun-crazy-show-offs.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
gun-crazy-show-offs.target: One friendly FLASH GITZ or TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.
gun-crazy-show-offs.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but it can only target that enemy unit.

where-dya-fink-youre-going.name: Where D’ya Fink You’re Going?
where-dya-fink-youre-going.summary: Units falling back from Beast Snaggas must make a desperate escape.
where-dya-fink-youre-going.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a Fall Back move while engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.
where-dya-fink-youre-going.effect: An enemy unit engaged with your unit that is selected to make a Fall Back move must use the desperate escape mode. If it is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, it makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 to those rolls if it is Battle-shocked.

goaded-into-action.name: Goaded Into Action
goaded-into-action.summary: A D6" surge move after being shot.
goaded-into-action.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
goaded-into-action.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound to those attacks.
goaded-into-action.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If it is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.
goaded-into-action.whileCalled: The D6 for the surge move can be re-rolled

instinctive-hunters.name: Instinctive Hunters
instinctive-hunters.summary: A unit near a board edge goes back into Strategic Reserves.
instinctive-hunters.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
instinctive-hunters.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
instinctive-hunters.effect: Place your unit into Strategic Reserves.

vindictive-artillerists.name: Vindictive Artillerists
vindictive-artillerists.summary: Mek Gunz gain Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 — or both, with Hazardous.
vindictive-artillerists.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.
vindictive-artillerists.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have one of the following:
• [LETHAL HITS].
• Or: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
• Or: [HAZARDOUS], [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1] together.

crazed-rampage.name: Crazed Rampage
crazed-rampage.summary: Destroyed walkers fight before they are removed, on a 4+.
crazed-rampage.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).
crazed-rampage.effect: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, adding 3 if your unit has DEFF DREAD. On a 4+ that model is not removed yet: it stays on the battlefield until your unit has fought or the phase ends, whichever comes first.

dread-power.name: Dread Power
dread-power.summary: One Walker unit is riled up for a turn.
dread-power.effect: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stomping-juggernaut.name: Stomping Juggernaut
stomping-juggernaut.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

keep-it-runnin.name: Keep It Runnin’
keep-it-runnin.summary: Infantry climb back into a nearby Transport after the fighting.
keep-it-runnin.target: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit it is able to embark within.
keep-it-runnin.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

readied-brawlers.name: Readied Brawlers
readied-brawlers.summary: Passengers pile out after the Wagon's Normal move.
readied-brawlers.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a Normal move.
readied-brawlers.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move (set up wholly within 3" of the Transport).

impending-krunch.name: Impending Krunch
impending-krunch.summary: A charging Wagon forces Battle-shock rolls at -1.
impending-krunch.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a Charge move.
impending-krunch.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a Battle-shock roll, with -1 to that roll.

delicious-eating-squigs.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
delicious-eating-squigs.summary: Squigbuggies heal nearby infantry by 3 wounds each.
delicious-eating-squigs.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

dakkastorm.name: Dakkastorm
dakkastorm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.
dakkastorm.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

speediest-freeks.name: Speediest Freeks
speediest-freeks.summary: Ranged attacks against your unit miss on unmodified 1-3.
speediest-freeks.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
speediest-freeks.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified Hit roll of 1-3.

flyin-headbutt.name: Flyin’ Headbutt
flyin-headbutt.summary: A destroyed aircraft crashes into an enemy: eight D6, mortal wound on each 4+.
flyin-headbutt.when: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.
flyin-headbutt.effect: Your unit does not have Deadly Demise. Instead, select one enemy unit within 12" of it and roll eight D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

long-uncontrolled-bursts.name: Long, Uncontrolled Bursts
long-uncontrolled-bursts.summary: Re-roll Hit rolls against FLY units.
long-uncontrolled-bursts.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT or DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.
long-uncontrolled-bursts.effect: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll the Hit roll.

whirligig-evasion.name: Whirligig Evasion
whirligig-evasion.summary: Deffkoptas move D6" when the enemy closes in.
whirligig-evasion.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
whirligig-evasion.target: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
whirligig-evasion.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6" — or of up to 6" if it is riled up.
whirligig-evasion.whileCalled: Move up to 6" instead of D6"
